correctness.rationale: The addition formula and antipodal parity reduce exact-degree rank to the 15x15 Legendre Gram. The supplied independent standard-library code reconstructs exact Q(phi) geometry, computes every rank through degree 14 by characteristic-zero field elimination, proves nonzero mod-1009 determinants for all 248 degrees 15..262, and checks the integer threshold used with the classical Legendre Bernstein bound for all degrees >=263. Its exact output was reproduced from the packaged source. No experimental inference replaces the infinite tail.

value.rationale: The icosidodecahedron is the canonical 30-edge-midpoint rectification between two dual Platonic solids. Classifying its one-degree harmonic interpolation is a natural complete invariant, useful for fixed-degree inverse problems; the degree-six five-dimensional deficit, first full degree seven, isolated loss at degrees eight and fourteen, and permanent threshold fifteen are distinct quantitative behaviors. The result is not merely an arbitrary chosen degree or restatement of known harmonic-index vanishing.
